name: Bioaqua Pure Skin Acne Removal & Rejuvenation Cream 30g For Men & Women
description:
Bioaqua Pure Skin Acne Removal & Rejuvenation Cream – 30g
For Men & Women

Restore your skin’s natural glow with Bioaqua Acne Removal & Rejuvenation Cream, specially formulated to combat acne, scars, and blemishes. Suitable for both men and women, this high-quality cream nourishes your skin while promoting a clearer, smoother complexion.

Key Features:

Effective Acne Treatment: Helps reduce acne, blemishes, and scars.

Anti-Wrinkle & Firming: Smoothens fine lines and tightens the skin.

Moisturizing & Nourishing: Keeps skin hydrated and healthy.

Oil Control & Pore Shrinking: Helps regulate oil production and minimize pores.

Natural Aloe Extract: Soothes skin and protects against sun-induced redness and irritation.

Package Includes:

1 x Bioaqua Acne Removal & Rejuvenation Cream (30g) – 100% brand new

Origin: China
